summary: 2026: SuperFile takes title/naming rights, running across bike bodywork and rider suits from the Hungarian GP and at all remaining 2026 rounds except Indonesia and Malaysia, where the Gulf livery continues (club release, 2026-06-05). Team partners listed by Trackhouse (partners page, July 2026): Aprilia, Beta, GNG New Tech, Gulf, Kappa, Karhu, Michelin, RCB, SuperFile. sponsorsComplete is false because decal-level placements on the bike/leathers could not be itemized from text sources.
